checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-CLIENT-SENDS-REQUEST: Validate filter option field types at RPC entry point
checklist.detection_procedure: Send eth_getLogs/eth_newFilter requests with malformed filter options: (1) non-hex blockHash values, (2) incorrect JSON types for DATA-FILTER-OPTIONS fields (numbers instead of strings, arrays instead of objects), (3) missing required fields, (4) extra unexpected fields. Verify the node returns proper JSON-RPC error codes (-32602 invalid params) and does not crash, leak internal state, or proceed with partial parsing.
executable_checks: Send filter request with blockHash as integer instead of hex string -> expect -32602
Send filter request with address field as number -> expect -32602
Send filter request with topics as nested arrays beyond expected depth -> expect rejection
Send filter request with null filter options object -> expect -32602
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP234-Pre-condition-003. Boundary edge EDGE-CLIENT-SENDS-REQUEST from EXT-USER-JSON-RPC-FILTER into eth_getLogs/eth_newFilter RPC endpoint. Covers nodes: STATE-RPC-REQUEST-RECEIVED, ACTION-PARSE-FILTER-OPTIONS.

checklist.title: Verify internal parsing logic correctly rejects type-confused filter fields after boundary crossing
checklist.detection_procedure: After data crosses the RPC boundary, verify that ACTION-PARSE-FILTER-OPTIONS enforces strict type checking on DATA-FILTER-OPTIONS and DATA-BLOCK-HASH. Attempt to pass values that are syntactically valid JSON but semantically incorrect (e.g., a valid hex string that is 31 bytes instead of 32 for blockHash). Confirm that the parser rejects these before any downstream processing occurs.
executable_checks: Send blockHash with 31-byte hex value -> expect rejection at parse stage
Send blockHash with 33-byte hex value -> expect rejection at parse stage
Send blockHash with '0x' prefix but non-hex characters -> expect rejection
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP234-Pre-condition-003. Supporting node check for ACTION-PARSE-FILTER-OPTIONS verifying correct internal handling post-boundary.

checklist.title: Falsify: Attempt to demonstrate query result stability across chain reorganizations
checklist.detection_procedure: Set up a scenario where a block referenced by blockHash becomes orphaned during a chain reorganization. (1) Query eth_getLogs with blockHash before the reorg, record results. (2) Trigger or wait for a reorg that orphans the target block. (3) Re-query with the same blockHash. (4) Verify the node handles this correctly - either returning an error (block not found on canonical chain) or clearly indicating the block is no longer canonical. The falsification target: prove that the node returns stale results without warning after a reorg.
executable_checks: Query blockHash-based filter -> trigger reorg -> re-query same hash -> verify error or different result
Verify node does not silently return logs from orphaned blocks as if canonical
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP234-Pre-condition-005. Pre-condition on STATE-BLOCK-FOUND. Tests assumption ASSUM-EIP234-02.

checklist.title: Falsify: Verify invalid hash formats cannot bypass validation and reach block lookup
checklist.detection_procedure: After the mutual exclusivity check passes (STATE-NO-CONFLICT), supply blockHash values with subtle format violations: (1) valid hex but wrong length (31 or 33 bytes), (2) mixed-case hex with non-hex chars at boundaries, (3) missing 0x prefix, (4) empty string. Verify ACTION-VALIDATE-HASH-FORMAT rejects all of these before any block lookup occurs. Check that no database query is made for invalid hashes.
executable_checks: Supply 31-byte blockHash after passing exclusivity check -> verify rejection before block lookup
Supply blockHash without 0x prefix -> verify rejection
Supply empty string blockHash -> verify rejection
Monitor database/trie access to confirm no lookup occurs for invalid formats
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP234-Post-condition-003. Post-condition on ACTION-VALIDATE-HASH-FORMAT. Covers STATE-NO-CONFLICT -> ACTION-VALIDATE-HASH-FORMAT -> STATE-HASH-FORMAT-VALID path.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-RECEIVE-EOF: Reject containers with invalid metadata markers
checklist.detection_procedure: Deploy EOF containers with: (1) metadata marker replaced with other values (0x00-0x04, 0x06-0xFF), (2) missing metadata section entirely, (3) metadata marker at wrong position in header, (4) duplicate metadata markers. Verify the EL rejects all malformed containers during validation at the deployment boundary. Confirm no partial parsing occurs.
executable_checks: Deploy EOF container with marker 0x04 instead of 0x05 -> expect rejection
Deploy EOF container with marker 0x06 -> expect rejection
Deploy EOF container with no metadata section -> expect rejection per spec
Deploy EOF container with metadata marker after data section -> expect rejection
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP7834-Pre-condition-003. Boundary edge EDGE-RECEIVE-EOF from EXT-CONTRACT-DEPLOYER into EOF container validation. Covers ACTION-CHECK-METADATA-MARKER, STATE-METADATA-PRESENT.

checklist.title: Verify metadata marker identification handles all unrecognized section types
checklist.detection_procedure: Craft EOF containers where section type bytes range from 0x00 through 0xFF (excluding valid types). For each, confirm that ACTION-CHECK-METADATA-MARKER correctly identifies 0x05 as metadata and rejects all others. Pay special attention to boundary values adjacent to valid section types.
executable_checks: Enumerate all 256 possible section type bytes -> verify only valid types accepted
Test section type 0x00 (null) -> expect rejection
Test section type 0xFF -> expect rejection
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP7834-Pre-condition-003. Supporting node check for ACTION-CHECK-METADATA-MARKER post-boundary.

checklist.title: Falsify: Attempt to trigger protocol-level validation on metadata content bytes
checklist.detection_procedure: Deploy EOF containers with various metadata content payloads: (1) all zeros, (2) all 0xFF bytes, (3) valid CBOR encoding, (4) invalid CBOR, (5) extremely large metadata (near 65535 bytes), (6) metadata containing EVM opcodes. Verify the protocol does not inspect, validate, or reject based on metadata content. The invariant holds if all containers with valid structure but arbitrary metadata content are accepted identically.
executable_checks: Deploy container with random metadata bytes -> expect acceptance
Deploy container with metadata containing invalid CBOR -> expect acceptance
Deploy container with metadata of all 0xFF -> expect acceptance
Compare gas costs across different metadata contents -> expect identical
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP7834-Invariant-001. Invariant on STATE-METADATA-VALID. Related to AMB-EIP7834-02.

checklist.title: Falsify: Verify bytecode comparison cannot be fooled by metadata manipulation
checklist.detection_procedure: Compile a contract, deploy it, then attempt verification with: (1) identical source but different metadata -> expect verification SUCCESS (metadata excluded), (2) modified non-metadata bytecode with original metadata -> expect verification FAILURE, (3) bytecode where metadata boundary is shifted by 1 byte -> expect FAILURE. The falsification target: find a case where different executable bytecode passes verification due to incorrect metadata stripping.
executable_checks: Recompile with different compiler settings (changes metadata) -> verify still passes
Modify one opcode in executable section -> verify fails
Shift metadata boundary offset by 1 byte -> verify fails
Truncate executable section by 1 byte, extend metadata by 1 -> verify fails
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP7834-Post-condition-002. Post-condition on ACTION-COMPARE-BYTECODE. Covers STATE-VERIFIED and STATE-VERIFICATION-FAILED.

checklist.title: Falsify: Attempt to produce a valid block where computed roots diverge from header values
checklist.detection_procedure: Construct blocks where: (1) state root is manually set to a different valid trie root, (2) transaction root computed from a reordered transaction list, (3) receipt root uses a different RLP encoding, (4) logs bloom has one bit flipped. Apply these blocks and verify ACTION-VERIFY-ROOTS rejects each case. Confirm the comparison is byte-exact for all four root values.
executable_checks: Submit block with state root from parent block -> expect rejection at EDGE-VERIFY-ROOTS
Submit block with transactions reordered -> expect transaction root mismatch
Submit block with one bloom bit flipped -> expect bloom mismatch
Submit block with receipt from different block -> expect receipt root mismatch
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-BYZANTIUM-Post-condition-001. Post-condition on ACTION-VERIFY-ROOTS. Covers STATE-BODY-APPLIED -> ACTION-VERIFY-ROOTS -> STATE-BLOCK-VALID.

checklist.title: Falsify: Attempt to obtain gas refund exceeding 50% of consumed gas
checklist.detection_procedure: Execute transactions designed to maximize refund accumulation: (1) clear many storage slots in a single transaction to accumulate large refunds, (2) verify the final refund is capped at exactly floor(gasUsed / 2), (3) test with odd gasUsed values to verify floor division, (4) test with gasUsed = 1 (minimum). The falsification target: achieve a refund > 50% of gas consumed.
executable_checks: Clear 100 storage slots, verify refund <= floor(gasConsumed/2)
Execute tx with gasUsed=1, verify refund=0
Execute tx with gasUsed=3 and accumulated refund of 5, verify actual refund=1
Verify refund cap applies after all refund additions, not per-operation
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-BYZANTIUM-Post-condition-004. Post-condition on ACTION-CALCULATE-REFUND.

checklist.title: Falsify: Violate difficulty adjustment multiplier by manipulating ommer presence
checklist.detection_procedure: Test difficulty calculation with: (1) parent block with 0 ommers -> verify multiplier is 1, (2) parent block with 1 ommer -> verify multiplier is 2, (3) parent block with 2 ommers -> verify multiplier is 2 (not 3), (4) parent block with maximum ommers -> verify multiplier is still 2. The invariant is a boolean: has_ommers ? 2 : 1. The falsification target: find a case where the multiplier is neither 1 nor 2, or where the ommer count affects it beyond the boolean.
executable_checks: Calculate difficulty with 0 ommers -> verify multiplier=1
Calculate difficulty with 1 ommer -> verify multiplier=2
Calculate difficulty with 2 ommers -> verify multiplier=2 (not 3)
Verify no intermediate ommer count produces multiplier != {1,2}
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-BYZANTIUM-Invariant-002. Invariant on ACTION-CALCULATE-DIFFICULTY. Related to AMB-BYZANTIUM-01.

checklist.title: Falsify: Bypass ECDSA recovery to produce invalid or contract sender address
checklist.detection_procedure: Submit transactions with: (1) signature where v is out of range (not 27/28 or EIP-155 adjusted), (2) r or s at boundary values (0, 1, secp256k1 order - 1, secp256k1 order), (3) signature that recovers to a known contract address, (4) malleable signatures (high-s). Verify ACTION-RECOVER-SENDER rejects invalid signatures and ACTION-CHECK-EOA rejects contract addresses as senders.
executable_checks: Submit tx with r=0 -> expect invalid signature rejection
Submit tx with s > secp256k1_order/2 (high-s) -> expect rejection per EIP-2
Submit tx with signature recovering to known contract address -> expect EOA check failure
Submit tx with v=26 -> expect recovery failure
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-BYZANTIUM-Pre-condition-006. Pre-condition on ACTION-RECOVER-SENDER and ACTION-CHECK-EOA.

checklist.title: Falsify: Demonstrate bloom filter bit derivation deviating from 3-bit keccak256 extraction
checklist.detection_procedure: For known test vectors: (1) compute keccak256 of log entries, (2) manually extract 3 bit positions using big-endian 11-bit extraction from first 6 bytes (bytes[0:2] & 0x7FF, bytes[2:4] & 0x7FF, bytes[4:6] & 0x7FF), (3) compare against the actual bloom filter produced by the client. Verify exactly 3 bits are set per entry. Test with entries that produce colliding bit positions (2 or 3 of the 3 positions are equal).
executable_checks: Compute bloom for address 0x0000...0001 manually -> compare with client output
Verify exactly 3 bits set per single-entry bloom
Test entry where two extracted positions collide -> verify only 2 unique bits set in filter
Verify big-endian byte ordering (not little-endian) in bit extraction
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-BLOOM-Invariant-001. Invariant on ACTION-SET-BLOOM-BITS. Covers the full keccak -> extract -> set pipeline.

checklist.title: Falsify: Find a log entry whose address or topic bits are missing from the completed bloom
checklist.detection_procedure: Execute a transaction that emits multiple log entries with distinct addresses and topics. Retrieve the block's logsBloom. For each log address and each topic, verify its bloom bits are present in the block bloom. Test edge cases: (1) log with zero topics, (2) log with maximum topics (4), (3) log with address 0x0, (4) multiple logs from same address. The falsification target: find any address or topic whose bits are absent.
executable_checks: Emit log with 4 topics -> verify all 4 topic bit patterns present in bloom
Emit log with 0 topics -> verify address bits present
Emit logs from 10 different addresses -> verify all 10 address patterns in bloom
Verify bloom is OR-combination of all individual entry blooms
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-BLOOM-Post-condition-003. Post-condition on STATE-BLOOM-COMPLETE.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-TX-TRIGGERS: Validate transaction triggering SELFDESTRUCT
checklist.detection_procedure: Submit transactions intended to trigger SELFDESTRUCT with: (1) invalid signature, (2) insufficient gas for SELFDESTRUCT execution, (3) gas exactly at SELFDESTRUCT cost boundary, (4) nonce gaps. Verify the boundary correctly validates transaction authenticity and gas sufficiency before allowing SELFDESTRUCT execution. The transaction must be fully valid before the opcode executes.
executable_checks: Submit tx calling SELFDESTRUCT with gas just below cost -> expect out-of-gas, no state change
Submit tx calling SELFDESTRUCT with gas exactly at cost -> expect success
Submit unsigned tx targeting SELFDESTRUCT contract -> expect rejection at boundary
Verify SELFDESTRUCT only executes within a valid, signed, gas-sufficient transaction
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP6049-Pre-condition-001. Boundary edge EDGE-TX-TRIGGERS. No trust model entry found; applying general transaction boundary validation.

checklist.title: Falsify: Verify SELFDESTRUCT deprecation status is correctly flagged
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify that: (1) SELFDESTRUCT opcode (0xFF) still executes with current semantics on supported forks, (2) client documentation or tooling flags it as deprecated, (3) new contract deployments using SELFDESTRUCT generate warnings if applicable. The invariant asserts current behavior works but may change. Verify behavior matches current fork rules exactly.
executable_checks: Deploy contract using SELFDESTRUCT on current fork -> verify it executes
Verify SELFDESTRUCT behavior matches EIP-6780 (Dencun) restrictions if applicable
Check that compiler/tooling warnings exist for SELFDESTRUCT usage
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP6049-Invariant-001. Invariant on STATE-OPCODE-DEPRECATED. Related to AMB-EIP6049-01.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-PEER-SENDS-BLOCK: Validate Gloas fork beacon block gossip uses bid-based validation
checklist.detection_procedure: On a Gloas-fork-enabled network: (1) send a beacon block via gossip with a traditional execution payload (no bid) -> verify rejection, (2) send a beacon block with a valid bid but invalid execution payload reference -> verify bid-based validation catches it, (3) send a pre-Gloas format block -> verify it is rejected under Gloas rules. Confirm execution payload checks are fully replaced by bid-based validation.
executable_checks: Gossip beacon block with execution payload (no bid) on Gloas fork -> expect rejection
Gossip beacon block with valid bid structure -> expect bid-based validation path
Gossip pre-Gloas format block -> expect rejection
Verify no execution payload validation occurs for Gloas blocks
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-GLOAS-P2P-Pre-condition-002. Boundary edge EDGE-PEER-SENDS-BLOCK from EXT-NETWORK-PEER-P2P. Covers ACTION-VALIDATE-BEACON-BLOCK-GOSSIP.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-PEER-SENDS-ENVELOPE: Validate KZG commitments in relocated bid message
checklist.detection_procedure: Send execution payload envelopes via gossip with: (1) valid KZG commitments in bid message -> expect acceptance, (2) invalid KZG commitments (wrong curve point) -> expect rejection, (3) KZG commitments in old location (payload instead of bid) -> expect rejection, (4) mismatched KZG commitment count vs blob count -> expect rejection. Verify validation occurs at the gossip boundary before further processing.
executable_checks: Send envelope with invalid KZG point (not on BLS12-381 G1) -> expect rejection
Send envelope with KZG commitments in payload body instead of bid -> expect rejection
Send envelope with 3 blobs but 2 KZG commitments -> expect rejection
Send envelope with valid KZG commitments -> expect acceptance past boundary
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-GLOAS-P2P-Pre-condition-006. Boundary edge EDGE-PEER-SENDS-ENVELOPE from EXT-BUILDER-BID into gossipsub validation. Related to AMB-GLOAS-P2P-03.

checklist.title: Falsify: Accept a bid where fee_recipient or gas_limit does not match proposer preferences
checklist.detection_procedure: Register proposer preferences for a slot (specific fee_recipient and gas_limit). Submit bids with: (1) correct fee_recipient but wrong gas_limit, (2) correct gas_limit but wrong fee_recipient, (3) both wrong, (4) fee_recipient differing by one byte. Verify ACTION-CHECK-BID-MATCHES-PREFS performs exact match on both fields and rejects all mismatches.
executable_checks: Submit bid with fee_recipient off by 1 byte -> expect rejection
Submit bid with gas_limit off by 1 -> expect rejection
Submit bid with both fields correct -> expect acceptance
Submit bid with fee_recipient=0x0 when proposer set non-zero -> expect rejection
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-GLOAS-P2P-Post-condition-001. Post-condition on ACTION-CHECK-BID-MATCHES-PREFS.

checklist.title: Falsify: Manipulate builder registration status in beacon state
checklist.detection_procedure: Attempt to: (1) submit a bid from a non-registered builder -> verify rejection, (2) deregister a builder and immediately submit a bid -> verify rejection, (3) forge beacon state to show a deregistered builder as active -> verify the state transition is invalid. The invariant asserts that builder active status in beacon state cannot be manipulated.
executable_checks: Submit bid from unregistered builder pubkey -> expect rejection
Deregister builder, submit bid in same epoch -> expect rejection
Verify builder registration status is read from finalized state, not mutable cache
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-GLOAS-P2P-Invariant-002. Invariant on ACTION-VALIDATE-EXEC-PAYLOAD-BID. Related to ASSUM-GLOAS-P2P-01.

checklist.title: Falsify: Demonstrate SSTORE no-op (current == new) charges gas != 200
checklist.detection_procedure: Execute SSTORE where current value equals new value in various scenarios: (1) slot never written (original == current == new == 0), (2) slot previously written to non-zero (original == current == new != 0), (3) slot written then reverted to original in same tx. Measure gas consumed by the SSTORE opcode. Verify exactly 200 gas in all no-op cases.
executable_checks: SSTORE(slot, 0) where slot is zero -> measure gas == 200
SSTORE(slot, X) where slot already equals X (non-zero) -> measure gas == 200
SSTORE(slot, X) after SSTORE(slot, Y) then SSTORE(slot, X) in same tx -> verify no-op gas
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP1283-Post-condition-001. Post-condition on ACTION-CHARGE-NOOP-GAS.

checklist.title: Falsify: Verify clearing a fresh non-zero slot adds exactly 15000 to refund counter
checklist.detection_procedure: Set a storage slot to a non-zero value in a previous transaction (making it 'fresh' with original == current != 0). In a new transaction, SSTORE the slot to zero. Measure the refund counter increment. Verify it is exactly 15000. Test edge cases: (1) slot value = 1 (minimum non-zero), (2) slot value = 2^256-1 (maximum), (3) multiple slots cleared in same tx (verify additive refunds).
executable_checks: Clear slot with value=1 -> verify refund += 15000
Clear slot with value=MAX_UINT256 -> verify refund += 15000
Clear 3 fresh non-zero slots -> verify total refund increment = 45000
Clear a dirty slot (current != original, set to zero) -> verify different refund rules apply
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP1283-Post-condition-005. Post-condition on ACTION-ADD-15000-REFUND.

checklist.title: Falsify: Demonstrate original value changing within nested calls
checklist.detection_procedure: Execute a contract that: (1) reads original value of slot S, (2) calls another contract via CALL that writes to slot S, (3) in a nested CALL back to the original contract, reads original value of S again. Verify the original value is the same in step 1 and step 3 (the value at transaction start). The falsification target: find a scenario where original value changes mid-transaction.
executable_checks: ContractA reads original(S), calls ContractB which writes S, ContractB calls back ContractA which reads original(S) -> verify same
SSTORE(S, X) then DELEGATECALL -> verify original(S) still reflects tx-start value
Verify original value after REVERT of nested call still reflects tx-start value
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP1283-Invariant-002. Invariant on ACTION-GET-ORIGINAL-VALUE. Related to AMB-EIP1283-01.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-RPC-CLIENT-REQUEST: Validate fork activation determination for uncle queries
checklist.detection_procedure: Send eth_getUncleByBlockNumberAndIndex requests with: (1) block number at exact EIP-1559 fork boundary, (2) block number one below fork, (3) block number one above fork, (4) invalid block number formats, (5) out-of-range uncle indices. Verify the RPC boundary correctly validates inputs and determines fork status to include/exclude baseFee.
executable_checks: Query uncle at block fork_block-1 -> verify no baseFee in response
Query uncle at block fork_block -> verify baseFee present
Query with negative block number -> expect error
Query with uncle index > max ommers -> expect null result
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP3046-Pre-condition-002. Boundary edge EDGE-RPC-CLIENT-REQUEST from EXT-USER-JSON-RPC-UNCLE. Covers ACTION-CHECK-FORK-STATUS.

checklist.title: Falsify: Show baseFee field present in uncle response on non-EIP-1559 chain
checklist.detection_procedure: On a chain configuration where EIP-1559 is not activated (e.g., a custom testnet or historical pre-London blocks): (1) query uncle blocks via eth_getUncleByBlockNumberAndIndex, (2) inspect the JSON response for presence of 'baseFeePerGas' field. The field must be absent. Test across multiple uncle blocks at various heights on non-1559 chains.
executable_checks: Query uncle on pre-London block -> verify 'baseFeePerGas' key absent from response
Query uncle on custom chain with no EIP-1559 -> verify field omitted
Verify field is null-omitted, not present with null value
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP3046-Pre-condition-003. Pre-condition on ACTION-CHECK-FORK-STATUS. Related to AMB-EIP3046-02.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-DAPP-REQUEST-SWITCH: Validate dapp identity display before chain switch
checklist.detection_procedure: Invoke wallet_switchEthereumChain from: (1) a dapp with a long/Unicode domain name, (2) a dapp with domain similar to a trusted site (homograph attack), (3) an iframe within another dapp. Verify the wallet displays the requesting origin accurately and shows target chain details before user confirmation. Verify no automatic switching occurs without user interaction.
executable_checks: Call wallet_switchEthereumChain from iframe -> verify correct origin shown (not parent)
Call from domain with Unicode homograph -> verify actual punycode domain shown
Verify user confirmation dialog appears before any chain switch occurs
Verify target chain name and chainId are displayed to user
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP3326-Pre-condition-003. Boundary edge EDGE-DAPP-REQUEST-SWITCH from EXT-DAPP-WALLET-SWITCH.

checklist.title: Verify switch confirmation UI correctly renders chain details and dapp identity
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify ACTION-SHOW-SWITCH-CONFIRMATION presents: (1) the exact requesting origin (not a truncated version), (2) the target chainId in both hex and human-readable form, (3) the chain name if known. Test with unknown chainIds to verify the wallet still shows raw chainId rather than hiding it.
executable_checks: Request switch to unknown chainId -> verify raw chainId displayed
Request switch to known chain -> verify human-readable name shown
Verify requesting dapp origin is not truncatable via long subdomain
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP3326-Pre-condition-003. Supporting node check for ACTION-SHOW-SWITCH-CONFIRMATION.

checklist.title: Falsify: Extract wallet chain support set through chain probing timing or error differences
checklist.detection_procedure: Call wallet_switchEthereumChain for multiple chainIds (supported and unsupported) and measure: (1) response timing differences, (2) error code differences, (3) error message text differences. The invariant requires that automatic rejection does not reveal whether a chain is supported. Verify responses are indistinguishable for supported vs unsupported chains when user rejects.
executable_checks: Probe 10 supported and 10 unsupported chains -> compare response times statistically
Verify error codes are identical for user-rejected vs unsupported chain
Verify error messages do not differ between supported-but-rejected and unsupported
Test rapid sequential probes -> verify no rate-limit behavior differences reveal support
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP3326-Invariant-001. Invariant on ACTION-MITIGATE-FINGERPRINTING.

checklist.title: Falsify: Trigger RIPEMD-160 precompile failure with valid-length input
checklist.detection_procedure: Call RIPEMD-160 precompile (address 0x03) with: (1) zero-length input, (2) 1-byte input, (3) 31-byte input, (4) 32-byte input, (5) very large input (e.g., 100KB), (6) input with all zero bytes, (7) input with all 0xFF bytes. Verify all calls succeed (given sufficient gas) and produce valid 32-byte output. The falsification target: find any valid byte sequence that causes an error other than out-of-gas.
executable_checks: CALL to 0x03 with empty input + sufficient gas -> expect success + 32-byte output
CALL to 0x03 with 1 byte input -> expect success
CALL to 0x03 with 100KB input + sufficient gas -> expect success
Verify output is always exactly 32 bytes regardless of input length
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-RIPEMD160-PRECOND-001. Pre-condition on STATE-RIPEMD160-CALLED. Related to ASSUM-CANCUN-RIPEMD160-05.

checklist.title: Falsify: Execute RIPEMD-160 without proper gas deduction
checklist.detection_procedure: Call RIPEMD-160 with various input sizes and gas limits: (1) gas = base_cost - 1 -> expect OOG, (2) gas = base_cost + word_cost * words - 1 -> expect OOG, (3) gas = exact required -> expect success, (4) verify gas consumption matches formula: 600 + 120 * ceil32(len)/32. Test with inputs at word boundaries (32, 64 bytes) and off-boundaries (31, 33, 63, 65).
executable_checks: Call with 0 bytes, gas=599 -> expect OOG
Call with 0 bytes, gas=600 -> expect success
Call with 32 bytes, gas=719 -> expect OOG (need 600+120=720)
Call with 33 bytes, gas=839 -> expect OOG (need 600+240=840, ceil32(33)=64)
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-RIPEMD160-PRECOND-002. Pre-condition on ACTION-CHARGE-RIPEMD-BASE. Related to AMB-CANCUN-RIPEMD160-02.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for CALLDATACOPY memory expansion gas charging
checklist.detection_procedure: Execute CALLDATACOPY with parameters designed to trigger large memory expansion: (1) destOffset at very high address with gas just below expansion cost -> verify OOG before any write, (2) destOffset + length causing overflow -> verify handled safely, (3) verify no partial memory write occurs on OOG. The boundary concern: gas must be charged before write.
executable_checks: CALLDATACOPY(destOffset=huge, offset=0, length=1) with insufficient gas -> expect OOG, no memory change
CALLDATACOPY with destOffset+length overflow -> expect handled (OOG or safe rejection)
Verify memory snapshot is unchanged after OOG CALLDATACOPY
CALLDATACOPY with exact gas for expansion -> verify success and correct memory content
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-ENV-PRECOND-002. Boundary property on ACTION-CALCULATE-MEMORY-EXPANSION. Covers EDGE-CALLDATACOPY-EXPANSION.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-BLOB-POP-INDEX: BLOBHASH index bounds checking
checklist.detection_procedure: Execute BLOBHASH opcode with: (1) index = 0 with 1 blob -> expect correct hash, (2) index = len(blobs) -> expect zero hash (not revert), (3) index = MAX_UINT256 -> expect zero hash, (4) index = -1 as uint256 (MAX_UINT256) -> expect zero hash, (5) non-blob transaction -> expect zero for any index. Verify bounds check returns zero, never reverts.
executable_checks: BLOBHASH(0) in tx with 1 blob -> expect versioned hash
BLOBHASH(1) in tx with 1 blob -> expect 0x0 (not revert)
BLOBHASH(MAX_UINT256) -> expect 0x0 (not revert or OOG)
BLOBHASH(0) in non-blob tx -> expect 0x0
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-ENV-PRECOND-004. Boundary edge EDGE-BLOB-POP-INDEX from EXT-USER-TX-SENDER into EVM BLOBHASH opcode.

checklist.title: Verify BLOBHASH lookup returns correct versioned hash for valid indices
checklist.detection_procedure: Submit a blob transaction with known blob data (precomputed versioned hashes). Execute BLOBHASH for each valid index and verify the returned hash matches the expected versioned hash. Test with maximum blobs per transaction.
executable_checks: Submit tx with 6 blobs -> BLOBHASH(0..5) returns correct hashes
Verify returned hashes have correct version prefix (0x01)
Verify hash ordering matches blob ordering in transaction
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-ENV-PRECOND-004. Supporting node check for ACTION-LOOKUP-VERSIONED-HASH.

checklist.title: Falsify: Accept BLAKE2b precompile call with final flag value other than 0 or 1
checklist.detection_procedure: Call BLAKE2b precompile (0x09) with 213-byte input where the last byte (final block flag) is set to: (1) 0 -> expect success, (2) 1 -> expect success, (3) 2 -> expect failure, (4) 128 -> expect failure, (5) 255 -> expect failure. Verify all values outside {0, 1} cause precompile failure (return failure, not revert). The falsification target: find any value > 1 that is accepted.
executable_checks: Call 0x09 with final_flag=0 -> expect success
Call 0x09 with final_flag=1 -> expect success
Call 0x09 with final_flag=2 -> expect failure (empty return)
Call 0x09 with final_flag=255 -> expect failure
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-BLAKE2-PRECOND-002. Pre-condition on ACTION-VALIDATE-FINAL-FLAG. Related to AMB-BLAKE2-01.

checklist.title: Falsify: Demonstrate BLAKE2b output deviating from 64-byte little-endian XOR finalization
checklist.detection_procedure: Use BLAKE2b test vectors (RFC 7693 Appendix A) with known inputs and expected outputs. Call the precompile with these inputs and compare byte-by-byte. Test: (1) standard test vectors, (2) single round (r=1), (3) maximum rounds (r=0xFFFFFFFF). Verify output is exactly 64 bytes in little-endian format and matches the XOR of state vector h[] with work vector halves.
executable_checks: RFC 7693 test vector -> compare precompile output byte-by-byte
Call with r=1 -> verify output matches single-round computation
Verify output is exactly 64 bytes
Verify little-endian encoding (compare first 8 bytes as uint64 LE)
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-BLAKE2-POSTCOND-001. Post-condition on ACTION-FINALIZE-OUTPUT.

checklist.title: Falsify: Accept a block with hash > 2^256/difficulty (invalid PoW)
checklist.detection_procedure: Construct blocks with: (1) nonce producing hash exactly at difficulty target -> expect acceptance, (2) nonce producing hash one above target -> expect rejection, (3) difficulty = 1 (any hash valid) -> expect acceptance, (4) difficulty = MAX (nearly impossible hash) with random nonce -> expect rejection. Verify the comparison is hash <= 2^256 / difficulty (not strict less-than).
executable_checks: Block with hash = target boundary exactly -> verify accepted
Block with hash = target + 1 -> verify rejected as invalid PoW
Block with difficulty=1 -> verify any nonce accepted
Block with manipulated nonce producing high hash -> verify STATE-POW-INVALID reached
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-GRAYGLA-PRECOND-003. Pre-condition on ACTION-VERIFY-POW.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for SSTORE gas stipend boundary check (strict >2300)
checklist.detection_procedure: Execute SSTORE with carefully controlled gas remaining: (1) gasleft = 2301 -> expect SSTORE succeeds (2301 > 2300), (2) gasleft = 2300 -> expect SSTORE fails (2300 is NOT > 2300), (3) gasleft = 2299 -> expect SSTORE fails. This is a strict greater-than check, not >=. The boundary is the exact value 2300. Test via a contract that consumes gas to reach exact remaining amounts before SSTORE.
executable_checks: Execute SSTORE with gasleft=2301 -> expect success
Execute SSTORE with gasleft=2300 -> expect failure (OOG/revert)
Execute SSTORE with gasleft=2299 -> expect failure
Verify the check is > not >= by confirming 2300 fails
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP2200-PRECOND-002. Boundary property. Related to AMB-EIP2200-01 and ASSUM-EIP2200-03.

checklist.title: Falsify: Show dirty-slot SSTORE charging gas != SLOAD_GAS (800)
checklist.detection_procedure: Execute SSTORE on dirty slots (where original != current) with various new values: (1) new == original (restoring), (2) new == 0 (clearing dirty slot), (3) new == some other value. In all cases, measure the gas charged for the SSTORE. Verify it is exactly 800 (SLOAD_GAS) regardless of the new value. Note: refunds may vary but the charge must be constant.
executable_checks: SSTORE(slot, A) then SSTORE(slot, B) in same tx -> second SSTORE costs 800
SSTORE(slot, A) then SSTORE(slot, 0) in same tx -> second SSTORE costs 800
SSTORE(slot, A) then SSTORE(slot, original) in same tx -> second SSTORE costs 800
Verify gas is 800 regardless of new value direction (up, down, zero, restore)
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP2200-POSTCOND-003. Post-condition on ACTION-CALCULATE-DIRTY-GAS.

checklist.title: Falsify: Achieve final gas refund exceeding 50% of gas consumed via SSTORE manipulation
checklist.detection_procedure: Design transactions that maximize refund accumulation through various SSTORE patterns: (1) clear many slots to accumulate clear refunds, (2) restore dirty slots to accumulate restore refunds, (3) combine clear and restore operations. After transaction, verify the effective refund (gas returned to user) never exceeds 50% of gasUsed. This caps the gas manipulation attack surface.
executable_checks: Clear 50 slots in one tx -> verify refund capped at 50% gasUsed
Combine clear + restore refunds -> verify total cap at 50%
Verify cap applies to sum of all refund sources, not per-operation
Compute theoretical uncapped refund and verify it would exceed 50% (proving cap is active)
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP2200-INV-003. Invariant on STATE-CLEAR-REFUND-ADDED. Related to AMB-EIP2200-03.

checklist.title: Falsify: Show coinbase balance increase deviating from base + nephew rewards formula
checklist.detection_procedure: Mine blocks with varying uncle configurations: (1) 0 uncles -> coinbase gets base reward only, (2) 1 uncle -> coinbase gets base + 1/32 * base, (3) 2 uncles -> coinbase gets base + 2/32 * base. Verify uncle miners get (8 - uncle_distance) / 8 * base_reward. Check exact wei amounts. Test with EIP-1234 reduced block reward (2 ETH).
executable_checks: Mine block with 0 uncles -> verify coinbase += 2 ETH exactly
Mine block with 1 uncle (distance 1) -> verify coinbase += 2 ETH + 2/32 ETH
Verify uncle miner gets (8-1)/8 * 2 = 1.75 ETH for distance-1 uncle
Verify all amounts are exact (no rounding errors in wei)
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP1234-POSTCOND-002. Post-condition on ACTION-CREDIT-COINBASE.

checklist.title: Falsify: Find a pre-existing Capella field modified during Deneb upgrade
checklist.detection_procedure: Take a snapshot of all Capella beacon state fields before the Deneb fork upgrade. Execute the upgrade. Compare every field: genesis_time, genesis_validators_root, slot, fork, latest_block_header, block_roots, state_roots, historical_roots, eth1_data, eth1_data_votes, eth1_deposit_index, validators, balances, randao_mixes, slashings, previous/current_epoch_participation, justification_bits, previous/current_justified_checkpoint, finalized_checkpoint, inactivity_scores, current_sync_committee, next_sync_committee, historical_summaries. All must be byte-identical.
executable_checks: Snapshot full Capella state -> upgrade to Deneb -> compare all fields byte-by-byte
Verify validators list is identical (no reindexing or reordering)
Verify balances array is unchanged
Verify sync committees are preserved exactly
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-DENEB-INV-001. Invariant on ACTION-VERIFY-FIELD-PRESERVATION. Related to ASSUM-DENEB-FORK-01.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EIP-7702 authorization signature validation
checklist.detection_procedure: Submit EIP-7702 transactions with authorization tuples containing: (1) valid ECDSA signature -> expect recovery to authority address, (2) signature with s in upper half (malleable) -> expect rejection, (3) y_parity not in {0,1} -> expect rejection, (4) r = 0 -> expect rejection, (5) s = 0 -> expect rejection, (6) signature recovering to zero address -> expect rejection. Verify invalid signatures cause authorization rejection with no side effects (no code delegation set).
executable_checks: Submit auth with valid signature -> verify authority address recovered correctly
Submit auth with high-s value -> expect authorization rejected
Submit auth with r=0 -> expect authorization rejected, no state change
Submit auth with y_parity=2 -> expect authorization rejected
Verify failed auth does not modify account code delegation
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-PRAGUE-PRECOND-002. Boundary property on ACTION-VALIDATE-AUTHORIZATION-SIGNATURE. Related to ASSUM-PRAGUE-FORK-TYPES-02.

checklist.title: Verify authority address recovery produces correct address from valid authorization signature
checklist.detection_procedure: Using known keypairs, create EIP-7702 authorization tuples and verify ACTION-RECOVER-AUTHORITY produces the exact expected address. Test with multiple keypairs and authorization payloads. Verify the signing domain is correct (chain_id, authorization structure).
executable_checks: Create auth tuple with known privkey -> verify recovered address matches pubkey-derived address
Verify signing hash includes chain_id correctly
Verify signing hash uses correct EIP-7702 type prefix
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-PRAGUE-PRECOND-002. Supporting node check for ACTION-RECOVER-AUTHORITY.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-WALLET-MESSAGE-RECEIVED: Validate postMessage origin before processing
checklist.detection_procedure: Set up a malicious page that sends postMessage events to the wallet provider page: (1) from a different origin -> verify message is discarded, (2) from a null origin (sandboxed iframe) -> verify discarded, (3) from the correct origin but with spoofed origin header (not possible in browser, but verify code checks event.origin not a custom field), (4) from a subdomain of the expected origin -> verify discarded. Confirm ACTION-VALIDATE-ORIGIN checks event.origin strictly.
executable_checks: Send postMessage from attacker.com -> verify message ignored
Send postMessage from sandboxed iframe (null origin) -> verify ignored
Send postMessage from subdomain of wallet provider -> verify ignored
Send postMessage from correct origin -> verify processed
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP7039-PRECOND-001. Boundary edge EDGE-WALLET-MESSAGE-RECEIVED. Related to AMB-EIP7039-02 and ASSUM-EIP7039-02.

checklist.title: Verify origin validation uses strict string comparison on event.origin
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify ACTION-VALIDATE-ORIGIN uses exact string match on event.origin, not substring match or regex. Test with origins that are superstrings, substrings, or similar to the expected origin. Verify case sensitivity handling.
executable_checks: Expected origin 'https://wallet.example.com' - test with 'https://wallet.example.com.evil.com' -> rejected
Test with 'https://WALLET.EXAMPLE.COM' -> verify case handling per spec
Test with 'http://wallet.example.com' (http vs https) -> rejected
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP7039-PRECOND-001. Supporting node check for ACTION-VALIDATE-ORIGIN.

checklist.title: Falsify: Demonstrate RPC request sent on a port other than the primary MessagePort
checklist.detection_procedure: Simulate wallet discovery where multiple MessagePort offers arrive: (1) verify the first port is stored as primary, (2) send an RPC request and verify it goes through the primary port, (3) attempt to inject a second port and verify RPC requests still use the primary, (4) verify no API exists to override the primary port after establishment.
executable_checks: Receive two ports sequentially -> verify first is stored as primary
Send RPC after both ports received -> verify traffic on first port
Attempt to replace primary port via second discovery message -> verify rejected
Verify no public method allows port reassignment
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP7039-INV-001. Invariant on STATE-PRIMARY-PORT-ESTABLISHED. Related to AMB-EIP7039-03.

checklist.title: Falsify: Show RIPEMD-160 gas cost deviating from 600 + 120 * ceil32(len)/32 formula
checklist.detection_procedure: Call RIPEMD-160 with input sizes at and around 32-byte boundaries and measure exact gas consumed. Verify the formula: cost = 600 + 120 * ceil32(len(data)) / 32. Key test points: len=0 (cost=600), len=1 (cost=720, ceil32(1)=32), len=32 (cost=720), len=33 (cost=840, ceil32(33)=64), len=64 (cost=840). The falsification target: find any input length where actual gas != formula result.
executable_checks: len=0 -> cost=600 (no word cost)
len=32 -> cost=720
len=64 -> cost=840
len=65 -> cost=960
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-RIPEMD160-INV-004. Invariant on ACTION-CALCULATE-RIPEMD-WORD-COUNT. Related to AMB-CANCUN-RIPEMD160-02.

checklist.title: Falsify: Demonstrate incorrect BLAKE2b rotation constants producing valid-looking but wrong outputs
checklist.detection_procedure: Using BLAKE2b test vectors, call the precompile and verify outputs match exactly. The rotation constants R1=32, R2=24, R3=16, R4=63 are critical. Any deviation would produce completely different outputs. Test with: (1) RFC 7693 test vectors, (2) all-zero input, (3) all-one input. Byte-exact comparison catches any rotation constant error.
executable_checks: RFC 7693 test vector -> verify exact output match
All-zero state + all-zero message + r=12 -> verify against reference implementation
Compare output with reference implementation for 100 random inputs
Verify single-round output (r=1) matches reference (isolates rotation errors)
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-BLAKE2-INV-004. Invariant on ACTION-XOR-ROTATE-D. Related to ASSUM-BLAKE2-01.
